description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'PrimaryBasedLogViewAdaptor' implementing log view adaptation with primary-based storage. It includes methods for reading, writing, submitting log entries, handling protocol messages, notifications, and synchronization logic within a distributed logging or event sourcing system. It manages pending updates, tentative and confirmed views, and supports features like notifications, stats collection, and batch processing.

classes.name: PrimaryBasedLogViewAdaptor
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for log view adaptors based on a primary source, supporting read/write operations, notifications, synchronization, and statistics within a distributed event sourcing or log management system.

classes.name: SubmissionEntry
classes.description: A container class for storing log submission entries queued for primary update, including entry data, submission timestamp, optional promise for completion, and conditional position.

methods.name: InitializeConfirmedView
methods.description: Abstract method to set the initial confirmed view of the log.

methods.name: LastConfirmedView
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the current confirmed global state.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current confirmed version number of the log.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously read the latest primary state, with retries until successful.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to apply pending entries to the primary storage asynchronously, returning number of entries written.

methods.name: MakeSubmissionEntry
methods.description: Creates a submission entry object from a log entry, adding protocol-specific info.

methods.name: OnMessageReceived
methods.description: Virtual method to process protocol messages; subclasses should override.

methods.name: RetrieveLogSegment
methods.description: Default method not supported; retrieves a segment of log entries.

methods.name: OnNotificationReceived
methods.description: Handles notifications, forwarding version notifications and batched messages, or throws if message type is unknown.

methods.name: ProcessNotifications
methods.description: Process stored notifications to determine if a refresh is needed.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merge two notification messages, override as needed.

methods.name: PreOnActivate
methods.description: Pre-activation hook; initializes state before activation.

methods.name: PostOnActivate
methods.description: Post-activation hook; starts background worker.

methods.name: PostOnDeactivate
methods.description: Cleanup after deactivation; waits for worker to finish.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a log entry for processing.

methods.name: SubmitRange
methods.description: Submits multiple log entries.

methods.name: TryAppend
methods.description: Attempts to append a log entry; returns success status asynchronously.

methods.name: TryAppendRange
methods.description: Attempts to append a range of log entries; returns success status asynchronously.

methods.name: OnProtocolMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages or notifications.

methods.name: EnableStatsCollection
methods.description: Initializes statistics collection.

methods.name: DisableStatsCollection
methods.description: Disables statistics collection.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Returns collected statistics.

methods.name: TentativeView
methods.description: Returns a tentative view of the log, combining confirmed state with pending entries.

methods.name: ConfirmedView
methods.description: Returns the confirmed, globally agreed view of the log.

methods.name: ConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed version number.

methods.name: UnconfirmedSuffix
methods.description: Provides the list of unconfirmed log entries pending primary write.

methods.name: Synchronize
methods.description: Forces synchronization with the primary source.

methods.name: ConfirmSubmittedEntries
methods.description: Confirms the status of submitted entries, waiting for their processing.

methods.name: NotifyPromises
methods.description: Completes the result promises of conditional submissions based on success or failure.

methods.name: RemoveStaleConditionalUpdates
methods.description: Removes updates that have already failed conditional positioning.
